versions.changelog: Declare PLACECALL_API_KEY -> api.voygr.tech for skill scanners; rephrase two withhold-worded lines as positive instructions; ship 6 SKILL.md fixes unpublished since 2026-08-30 (place-suggestion billing, outcome-list completeness, 402 handling, timed-out POST, notice wording).

PlaceCall 6.0.0 – Give your agent a voice to call any US business, handle real-world tasks by phone, and return verified outcomes and transcripts.

- Now supports placing calls to any US business for reservations, inquiries, and quotes with no local number required.
- Handles IVRs, holds, and transfers automatically, navigating business phone systems.
- Returns a verified call outcome, full call transcript, and recording for every interaction.
- Added "places/suggest" for smart business discovery and automatic call brief generation when only a description is provided.
- First 250 calls are free; outcome-based billing applies after that.
- Enhanced agent and data safety with rigorous pre-call, mid-call, and credential security checks.
- Comprehensive documentation on setup, limits, and risk mitigations included.
